disagreements.assessment: Judge's real reasoning was defensible - damage_assessor's own hard rule (190% repair-to-ACV ratio) already explained and resolved the apparent conflict. Proxy label may have been too strict, not the judge miscalibrated.
Similarly defensible - judge treated trivial wording differences as not rising to NOTABLE, arguably more conservative (fewer false positives) than the proxy label expected.

Genuine judge miscalibration - judge's own reasoning correctly identified 3/4 transparent steps plus one real unexplained gap, but still scored 0.0 (fully opaque) instead of reflecting partial transparency. The 'score collapse' failure mode flagged as a risk in the Nyckel calibration study this project reviewed earlier.
